location.ref: Naam or Word, on the Word in all scriptures

paraphrase: The Word — Nām, Shabd, Kalma, Logos — is spoken of in all scriptures as the power that created and sustains all; it is not the spoken or written name but the inner sound and light, contacted through a living Master.
speaker: Kirpal Singh
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.
